title: Choose the visual world of infer
question: The roll assigned The Dictionary of Inferences. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Dictionary of Inferences
options.lineage: pocket dictionaries on bible paper, with cut thumb-index tabs
options.thesis: infer is a dictionary: the wordmark is the headword, and every model is an entry you can run.
options.viewport: Guide words on top, a huge bold headword 'infer v.', its senses, then the sd-turbo entry with a prompt field and run, and a blue thumb tab on the fore-edge.
options.risk: Set timidly it falls into the cream-serif editorial look; it must stay bright paper, heavy grotesk and blue tabs.

raised.raise: Every state change snaps one whole line with one overshoot; a failed stage stops on a half-line.
Every number is seamed to its source run: device, date, file.
Blue is reserved for what runs now; everything at rest is black ink.
Each entry carries a numbered contents map of its pipeline with true sizes, and the unbroken download band means not stored yet.

options.label: The Datasheet
options.thesis: Each inference is a part with a datasheet: the phone's limits are its absolute maximum ratings.
options.viewport: Part number INFER-SD-TURBO huge, a features list, the absolute maximum ratings table (1920 MB, 250 ms), and Figure 1 as the live image.
options.risk: Engineers love it, which is why many developer tools already dress this way.

options.label: Inference Line Map
options.thesis: Each inference is a line; tokenizer, encoder, UNet and decoder are its stations.
options.viewport: The sd-turbo line runs down the phone, each station with its size and time, the image at the terminus.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: the pipeline is literally a line with stations; holds product clarity, loses on how engineers see themselves.
options.risk: With one model the map is one line, so it reads thin until more inferences ship.

options.label: Departure Board
options.thesis: The landing is the board: every available inference is a row whose flaps flip as it loads and runs.
options.viewport: A board of rows: sd-turbo, text to image, 2.24 GB, status, with the stage times flipping in place during a run.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: a list of inferences with live columns is a board; holds product clarity, loses on audience identification.
options.risk: Split-flap is a familiar developer-site trope and can read as a costume.

options.label: Destination Blind
options.thesis: Inferences as cloth courses on one stepping roll.
options.viewport: One fixed window that steps from course to course.
options.case: Fuses poorly: engineers do not see their work in a bus blind.
options.kept: Changes snap one whole line and overshoot; a fault is a half-step.
options.risk: One window hides the list the landing must show.

options.label: Memory Quilt
options.thesis: Each model a patch with its own history.
options.case: Fuses poorly on both axes for a GPU engine.
options.kept: Every caption is seamed to its source.
options.risk: Domestic warmth works against measured numbers.

options.label: Glazed Partition
options.thesis: Each model a pane in a black glazing grid.
options.viewport: A wall of panes, one lit.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a pane grid says little about how a model runs.
options.kept: Color is reserved for what matters now.
options.risk: Pretty, quiet, and mute about the mechanism.

options.label: Ekiben Kiosk
options.thesis: Each model a boxed meal with a contents map.
options.viewport: One lid per model, contents map beneath.
options.case: Fuses poorly with the audience, though the contents map is true to the pipeline.
options.kept: A numbered contents map that turns out exactly true, and the unbroken band as untouched.
options.risk: Food packaging distracts from the engineering.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: An on-device AI demo page, done well: dark ground, big claim, device mock, feature cards.
canonCard.viewport: Headline 'AI that runs on your iPhone', a phone mock with the image, three feature cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other AI launch page by design.
